verdict.rationale: Opting out of telemetry and usage tracking is a fair privacy question for a SaaS CRM, so the axis applies. The evidence pack covers authentication, integrations, permissions, 2FA and data export, but nothing on telemetry, analytics, or usage-tracking opt-out controls. Those features are adjacent and earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
